recommendations.action: Run a controlled optimization test that increases exposure to ticket/near-term-travel intent filters while preserving a scale guardrail.
recommendations.expected_impact: Higher A/B and Tier A share, conditional on not collapsing lead volume.
recommendations.guardrail: Do not reduce total commercial matched leads below an agreed minimum volume.
recommendations.review_condition: Review after sufficient matched commercial leads accumulate for comparison.

recommendations.action: Create a focused creative/adset test around FiltroBilletes and mature-intent messaging, separating cold commercial and activation contexts.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improve quality density; scale impact unknown.
recommendations.success_metric: A/B rate, Tier A rate, cost_per_ab_commercial_matched or activation observed matched cost per A/B with FARO layer separation.
recommendations.guardrail: Do not compare ATTENTION, ACTIVATION and COMMERCIAL as one universal KPI ranking.
recommendations.review_condition: Promote only if quality lift remains after sample-size review.

recommendations.action: Add a recurring evidence view that exposes matched, lead_only and spend_only by normalized ad_id and campaign signal.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduce ambiguity in future cost-quality decisions.
recommendations.success_metric: Coverage states visible in every AUC-001 execution.
recommendations.guardrail: Do not use ad_name as join key.
recommendations.review_condition: Close when future reports can cite the view without manual reconciliation.

recommendations.action: Treat post-lead quality and revenue as unresolved until GIAV/CRM evidence is authorized and reconciled.
recommendations.expected_impact: Prevents overclaiming lead quality as sales quality.
recommendations.success_metric: CRM/revenue coverage state changes from not_available to complete or partial in a future authorized scope.
recommendations.guardrail: Do not infer sales value from FARO tier alone.
recommendations.review_condition: Revisit after CRM source is governed and allowlisted.
